methodologyNotes: Products independently re-verified against official manufacturer product pages (Philips Hue US, LIFX, Govee US, Wyze, TP-Link Tapo, Nanoleaf US shop, GE Lighting/Cync, WiZ Connected, Kasa Smart) and corroborating retailers/reviews (Best Buy, PCWorld, Matter Alpha, Amazon, Home Depot). All 13 drafted models are real and retained; none removed. Two spec corrections applied: (1) Hue White A19 75W is FIXED 2700K warm white, not tunable_white; (2) Nanoleaf Essentials A19 does NOT require a hub for basic use (works standalone over Bluetooth), so hub_required corrected to false to match the stated definition. hub_required is a boolean: true means a separate hub/bridge is mandatory for ANY use; false means the bulb pairs directly via its native app over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or list price for a single bulb; multi-pack unit prices are noted. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Hue White and Color Ambiance A19 (75W equivalent)
products.provenance: Re-verified on the Philips Hue US product page: $59.99 single bulb, 'up to 1100 lumen', 9.5W, E26, Bluetooth+Zigbee, 25,000-hour nominal lifetime. Bridge is optional (works standalone over Bluetooth), so hub_required=false. All draft values confirmed unchanged.

products.name: Hue White A19 (75W equivalent)
products.provenance: Re-verified on the Philips Hue US product page: $17.99 single bulb, 1100lm, 10.5W, E26, Bluetooth+Zigbee, 25,000-hour lifetime. CORRECTION: this is FIXED warm white (2700K), dimmable to 5%, with NO color-temperature adjustment — color corrected from draft's 'tunable_white' to 'white'.

products.name: Hue White and Color Ambiance Essential A19
products.provenance: Re-verified on the Philips Hue US product page: $24.99 single bulb, 800lm, 8.8W, E26, Bluetooth+Zigbee, 25,000-hour lifetime, full color and tunable white (2200-6500K), dimmable to 2%. All draft values confirmed unchanged.

products.name: LIFX SuperColor A19 (1100 lm)
products.provenance: Re-verified on the LIFX official product page (titled 'LIFX SuperColor Smart Light 1-Pack - 1100 Lumens'): $29.99, 1100lm, 11.5W (75W equiv), E26, Wi-Fi 2.4GHz + Matter 1.3, no hub required, 1500K-9000K tunable white. Lifespan not published on the page; left null. All draft values confirmed unchanged.

products.name: LIFX Color A19 (800 lm)

products.name: Wyze Bulb Color

products.name: Sengled Zigbee Color A19
products.priceNote: Single bulb price from us.sengled.com (sold individually)
products.provenance: Product confirmed real via Sengled US store and Matter Alpha: Zigbee, hub required, 800lm, E26, 16M colors (2000-6500K). Single-bulb list ~$19.99. The Sengled storefront returns bot-protection codes to automated fetchers but the URL pattern (zigbee-*-a19-e26-hub-required) is confirmed via live sibling pages and search. Wattage not confirmed from accessible content; left null. Release year 2017 per Matter Alpha. Unchanged from draft.

products.name: TP-Link Tapo L530E Smart Wi-Fi Light Bulb
products.priceNote: Per-bulb estimate from 2-pack MSRP of $24.99; primarily sold in 2-/4-packs in the US
products.provenance: Re-verified on the TP-Link US product page: 800lm, 8.8W (60W equiv), A19/E26, IEEE 802.11b/g/n 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, no hub required, 25,000-hour lifespan, 2500-6500K. Per-bulb $12.50 from $24.99 2-pack. All draft values confirmed unchanged.

products.name: Nanoleaf Essentials Matter Thread A19
products.provenance: Re-verified on the Nanoleaf US shop product page: $19.99 single bulb, 1100lm max (806lm avg), 8.5W +/-10%, E26 (also E27/B22), Thread+Bluetooth (Matter-enabled), 25,000-hour lifespan, 16M+ colors (2700-6500K), CRI >=90. CORRECTION: hub_required changed true->false. Per Nanoleaf's own page, only Bluetooth is required for control via the Nanoleaf App; a Thread border router/Matter hub is needed only for full ecosystem integration, so a hub is NOT mandatory for basic use (matching the stated definition and how the Hue Bluetooth bulbs are scored).

products.name: GE Cync Full Color A19

Rated life 13.7 years (~15,000 hours), so lifespan_hours=15000 retained. Release year 2022 per Matter Alpha. All draft values confirmed unchanged.
